verdict.rationale: Auto-shutdown and spend limits are a fair axis for a GPU cloud, but no documentation shows Lambda offering either. A community report describes a forgotten GH200 instance billed for 391 hours, with support saying Lambda does not distinguish idle from in-use instances; the user's suggestion of auto-stop or limits went unanswered. Viewing monthly usage, the REST API, and cloud-init scripts are only adjacent tools a user could build around, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill
